signals.explanation: The largest loans added to the tape in the last year were pulled from the servicer system: 2 of 30 are 60+ days late or not there at all
Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 14 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Only 0 of 48 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (0%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later
'Canyon Specialty Finance LP' holds a lien on the borrower ('Keystone Supply LP': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing)

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0050 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Servicer-system pull: 3 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0050-SOURCE_MISMATCH-cb5cd324]
  - Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 14 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0050-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-d76b11ac]
  - Only 0 of 48 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (0%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later [ref S2-B0050-ROLL_RATE_TOO_LOW-a16af5e3]

Due: 2026-09-17 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
[DRAFT — synthetic demonstration data]
